questions.objective: Assess morning body heaviness, sluggishness, and tongue coating
questions.patient_text: When you wake up in the morning, do you experience heavy body stiffness or a thick white coating on your tongue? (Ama)

options.label: No — I wake up feeling light, active, and clean
Sometimes — Slight heaviness or occasional tongue coating
Yes — Thick white tongue coating, heavy body, sticky mouth, and lethargy every morning
